argument_setup: fallback routine moves its rsi into rdi (0x5d52b68)
fallback routine moves its rdx into rsi (0x5d52b6b)
consumer.role: stage 1 of the fallback lookup: a non-null result is returned at once

landing_pad: none: no landing-pad entry inside the routine FDE range; the routine has no exception cleanup block
not_claimed: what the owner object, the table, or the returned entry qword denote
what the 16-byte entries contain past their first qword
caller semantics beyond the site, the caller FDE range, and the argument setup

behaviour on dangling pointers, a null owner (the routine reads +0x988/+0x990 unconditionally, so the model raises on a null owner), or an out-of-range or negative index (the binary reads past the table unchecked; the model raises instead)

routine.returns: first qword of entry [index] (16-byte stride), or null when begin == end

table.empty_rule: begin == end returns null without reading any entry

trailing_bytes: bytes after the FDE range, 0x5d8ce53..0x5d8ce60, are int3 padding, not a landing-pad block
